info.shortcutHint: most actions are triggered by clicking in the statusbar or grid. keyboard shortcuts are minimal.
info.feature.whatIs.title: what is cipher-mux?
info.feature.whatIs.p1: cipher-mux is an electron app that manages multiple claude code sessions simultaneously in a single window. each session runs in its own tmux terminal. sessions can communicate via a message bus and are coordinated by an orchestrator.
info.feature.whatIs.p2: as soon as you work on multiple projects at the same time or a project is so large that a single claude agent hits its context limits. the orchestrator can distribute tasks and merge results.
info.feature.grid.title: grid layout
info.feature.grid.p1: the main window shows a grid with up to 5x3 cells. each cell can hold a terminal session. empty cells show a "+" button to start new sessions.
info.feature.grid.p2: adjust grid size via the "columns +/-" / "rows +/-" controls at the bottom right. reorder sessions via drag & drop. click a session header to set focus.
info.feature.grid.p3: "swap" in a session header opens the project picker. the old session is stopped and a new one starts in the same slot.
info.feature.orchestrator.title: orchestrator
info.feature.orchestrator.p1: the orchestrator is a special claude session that always runs in slot 0 (top left). it has access to all other sessions via the MCP server and can:
info.feature.orchestrator.li3: query context usage of all sessions
info.feature.orchestrator.p2: the orchestrator starts automatically with the app. use the "orchestrator" button in the statusbar to manually start/stop it.
info.feature.messageBus.title: message bus & chatroom
info.feature.messageBus.p1: all sessions share a SQLite-based message bus. sessions can send messages to topics (e.g. "broadcast", "orchestrator", "session:xyz"). the chatroom shows the entire bus feed in real time.
info.feature.messageBus.p2: the orchestrator uses the bus to distribute instructions. sessions can report results. you can see what happens between agents in the chatroom.
info.feature.mcp.title: MCP server
info.feature.mcp.p1: a local HTTP server (default port 3100) provides tools that claude sessions can use programmatically. the MCP server is automatically injected into every new session (via CLAUDE.md).
info.feature.mcp.p2: session management, message bus, context usage query, kickoff/project start. the orchestrator uses these tools to control other sessions.
info.feature.context.title: context usage monitoring
info.feature.context.p1: each session shows its current context usage in the header (0-100%). the color changes automatically:
info.feature.context.p2: data comes from claude's statusLine hook and updates in real time.
info.feature.bugreport.title: bugreport
info.feature.bugreport.p1: via "bugreport" in the statusbar (or Cmd+B) you can create a bug report. the description is optionally formatted by ollama (local LLM) into a structured format: title, severity, tags, steps, summary. the report lands as a markdown file in the outbox.
info.feature.themes.title: themes
info.feature.themes.p1: 10 themes are available — from cipher ivory (light, ceramic) through gruvbox, nord and blueprint to synthwave and matrix. each theme adjusts the entire app and all terminals instantly. switch via the theme picker in settings or by clicking the theme name in the statusbar. the choice is persisted.
info.feature.scanner.title: project scanner
info.feature.scanner.p1: cipher-mux scans configured directories for claude code projects (recognizable by CLAUDE.md, .claude/, package.json etc). found projects appear in the project picker when starting a new session.
info.feature.scanner.p2: scan paths and depth can be configured in the "settings" tab.
